summary: The marketing team is executing a two-track push — a seven-month SEO/AI-search visibility strategy led by Asia Star and the new Intelligent China program, and a knowledge website redesign now entering a focused feedback-and-revision cycle — while clearing near-term operational and content decisions this week.
summaryDetail: The most important thing in motion is the global marketing and SEO/AI-search strategy, which now has clear program priorities: Asia Star and Intelligent China lead, with US partner programs (Berkeley, Stanford, Columbia) held back and Berkeley as a possible third. To make that strategy actionable, Joseph must draft the target prompts and audience focus, and the team needs to analyze Asia Star participant profiles and CRM hot leads, plus audit the Google Ads conversion tracking once Joseph secures the setup brief. On the website front, the redesign review landed on a two-menu Knowledge/School structure, dispersing videos by topic, and folding BCI and BSI indices into the knowledge section, with Joseph, Julie, and the lead due to hold a 30-minute session to mark specific design feedback before Joker revises. This week also carries a cluster of content and event decisions: the November 13 CKGSB–EuroCham Shanghai event is cancelled, so Xuan's briefing email to Professor Tao needs to reflect that, while the 2026 Women in Leadership Forum promotion is kicking off and needs updated speaker titles on the Chinese event page. Rounding out the near-term load are the ESG report edits, the anniversary infographic planning, and the Business Sentiment Index translation awaiting Professor Li's greenlight.

decisions.text: Use the new password across all devices and remove stale saved credentials.
Remove the standalone videos section; disperse videos by topic instead.
Keep the two-menu structure (Knowledge and School) at the top.
Bring BCI and BSI indices into the knowledge section, similar to the school homepage banner.
Do not add a stock-market ticker at the very top.
Use the inspiration design selectively for layout ideas rather than adopting it wholesale.
Prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China as the top two programs to promote.
